lessons.words: wind – make a clock work by turning a key or handle; toil – work; restore – repair, bring back; tiny – very small; naughty – causing trouble; bucket – a container for carrying water; tap – a device to control water flow
ab: Listen, recite and enjoy – The Clock of Life (ಕವನ ಕೇಳಿ, ಹೇಳಿ ಆನಂದಿಸಿ) (p. 1)
Teacher recites the poem. Listen with your book closed, then with your book open.
ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರು ಕವನ ಹೇಳುವುದನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ. ನಂತರ ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರ ಜೊತೆ ಕವನ ಹೇಳಿ.
Speak / Read aloud – Yes or No (ಹೌದು / ಇಲ್ಲ) (p. 2–3)
Teacher says these words aloud: wound (n), wound (v), early, more, clock, power, lose, own, toil, restore. Listen and repeat.
Repeat after the teacher.
Man has the power to stop the clock of life.
No, he has not.
To lose one’s wealth is sad indeed.
Yes, it is.
We all give importance to health.
Yes, we do.
We should live, love and toil with will.
Yes, we should.
Read, speak and write – A. Fill in the blanks (ಖಾಲಿ ಜಾಗ ತುಂಬಿ) (p. 3)
The clock stops ___ or ___.
late; early
Losing wealth is ___ but losing health is sadder still.
sad
The loss of ___ cannot be restored.
soul
Read, speak and write – B. Name the household articles in the table (p. 4)
Picture of a house is given. Write the names of the household articles in the right column (living room, kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, dining hall).

Living room: sofa, television, telephone, chair | Kitchen: stove, cooker, spoons, glass | Bedroom: bed, pillow, curtain, alarm clock | Bathroom: tap, shower, bucket, bowl | Dining hall: dining table, table  (ಚಿತ್ರ ಆಧಾರಿತ – ಪಠ್ಯಪುಸ್ತಕದ ಚಿತ್ರ ನೋಡಿ; ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ)
images/class-4/english/c4-en-l01-house-articles.webp
Fill in the blanks using the clues (ಸುಳಿವು ಬಳಸಿ ಖಾಲಿ ಜಾಗ ತುಂಬಿ) (p. 5)
What’s a broom for? It’s for ___.
sweeping
What’s a cooker for? It’s for ___.
cooking
What’s a mixer for? It’s for ___.
grinding
What’s a wash basin for? It’s for ___.
washing
Listen and say aloud – Identify the pictures (ಚಿತ್ರ ಗುರುತಿಸಿ ಹೆಸರು ಹೇಳಿ) (p. 5)
Teacher says these words aloud: fill–feel, dip–deep, pull–pool, slip–sleep, bit–beat, ship–sheep, fit–feet, will–wheel, full–fool. Repeat after the teacher.
Repeat after the teacher.
Identify the pictures and say their names aloud.
door; bucket; spoons; fan; mattress (ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ); pin; stool; goat  (ಚಿತ್ರ ಆಧಾರಿತ)
images/class-4/english/c4-en-l01-identify.webp
Short vowel and long vowel (ಹ್ರಸ್ವ ಮತ್ತು ದೀರ್ಘ ಸ್ವರ) (p. 6)
Identify the words with short vowel and long vowel from the pictures (bedroom, tree, broom, shoes) and put them in the boxes.
Short vowel: bedroom (‘bed’ ನಲ್ಲಿ ಹ್ರಸ್ವ e) (ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ – ‘room’ ದೀರ್ಘ) | Long vowel: tree, broom, shoes
images/class-4/english/c4-en-l01-vowels.webp
Mother warned Sham not to ___ on the driver’s ___. (seat, sit)
sit; seat
I saw a huge ___ with a flock of ___ sailing to Sri Lanka. (ship, sheep)
ship; sheep  (ಪಠ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ‘Srilanka’ ಎಂದಿದೆ – ‘Sri Lanka’ ಎಂದು ತಿದ್ದಲಾಗಿದೆ)
A ___ feels that this world is ___ of fools. (full, fool)
fool; full
Grandma broke her ___ when she fell down on the ___ of stones. (hips, heap)
hips; heap
Buy shoes that ___ your ___. (feet, fit)
fit; feet
Sing and enjoy – Rhyme (ಪದ್ಯ ಹಾಡಿ ಆನಂದಿಸಿ) (p. 7)
Listen to the teacher singing the rhyme (Cup and saucer / Bed and pillow / Chair and table) and repeat.
ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರ ಜೊತೆ ಹಾಡು ಹೇಳಿ (ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆ).
Rhyme – fill in the blanks using the pictures (ಚಿತ್ರ ನೋಡಿ ಖಾಲಿ ಜಾಗ ತುಂಬಿ) (p. 8)
This is a word which rhymes with bridge. I’m very cold because I’m a ___.
fridge
images/class-4/english/c4-en-l01-rhyme.webp
This is a word which rhymes with up. You can pour into me and drink. I’m a ___.
cup
I’m good for journey when you’re going far. I need lots of petrol because I’m a ___.
car
This is a word which rhymes with spoon. I shine at night because I’m a ___.
moon
This is a word which rhymes with bake. I’m tasty to eat because I’m a ___.
cake
I’m a circle, a bright shiny thing. It’s on my fourth finger and I’m a ___.
ring
Fill in the boxes – picture clues (ಚಿತ್ರ ಸುಳಿವು ನೋಡಿ ಪದ ತುಂಬಿ) (p. 9)
1. Picture: toothbrush (given as example)
TOOTHBRUSH
images/class-4/english/c4-en-l01-crossword.webp
2. Picture: nail cutter
NAIL CUTTER
3. Picture: toothpaste
TOOTHPASTE
4. Picture: glass of water
WATER
5. Picture: towel
TOWEL
6. Picture: soap
SOAP
7. Picture: comb
COMB
8. Picture: bottle of oil
OIL
The Naughty Onion – Read and enjoy (ಕಥೆ ಓದಿ ಆನಂದಿಸಿ) (p. 10–11)
Teacher reads the lesson. Listen with your book closed, then with your book open. Learn the new words: tiny – small; naughty – causing trouble.
ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರು ಕಥೆ ಓದುವುದನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ; ನಂತರ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ತೆರೆದು ಓದಿ.
Match the words in list A with the words in list B. – 1. Onions
d. red and white
2. Knife
c. sharp
3. Gopu
a. tired
4. Voice
b. soft
Fill in the blanks with the words above and say the sentences aloud (p. 12)
Gopu bought onions. Some were ___ and some were ___.
big; small  (ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಪದಗಳ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ – ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ)
He took a ___ knife.
sharp
Gopu was very ___.
tired
The onions spoke in a ___ voice.
soft
Write well – answer orally and then in writing (p. 12)
What did Gopu buy from the market?
Gopu bought a kilo of onions from the vegetable seller.
What did the naughty onion ask the others to do?
He told the other onions to jump out of the packet.
The onions were found in ___ (fill in the blanks). a) ___ b) ___ c) ___
a) under the cupboard  b) in a corner  c) behind the dustbin  (ಕಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇನ್ನೂ ಸ್ಥಳಗಳು ಇವೆ: pot, oven)
Why do you think the dinner was a bit late?
Because Gopu took a long time to collect all the onions.
Fun with words – write sentences using the given words (p. 12)
(bright, happy, loaded, large, flying, pretty, round) e.g. The sun is bright. 1. The children are ___
The children are happy.
2. The lorry is ___ (loaded)
The lorry is loaded with bricks.
3. The elephant is ___ (large)
The elephant is large.
4. The bird is ___ (flying)
The bird is flying.
5. The flower is ___ (pretty)
The flower is pretty.
Speak and write – question words (ಪ್ರಶ್ನಾರ್ಥಕ ಪದ ಆರಿಸಿ) (p. 13–14)
A. ___ is this? (computer) — Answer: A.
What is this? It is a computer.
images/class-4/english/c4-en-l01-question-words.webp
B. ___ do you go to school? (bus) — Answer: B.
How do you go to school? By bus.
C. ___ is this? (a man lying on a wooden bench)
Who is this? It is a man.
D. ___ is your toy? (toys)
Which is your toy? It is the drum.
E. ___ is the vase? (table with vase)
Where is the vase? It is on the table.
F. ___ is the baby laughing? (baby)
Why is the baby laughing? Because it is happy.
G. ___ do you wake up in the morning? (alarm clock)
When do you wake up in the morning? At 6 o’clock.
H. ___ phones are there? (two phones)
How many phones are there? There are two phones.
I. ___ books are these? (books)
Whose books are these? They are my books.
An evening at home – frame questions (ಸಂಜೆ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ) (p. 14–15)
Look at the picture and frame at least five questions. e.g. What is the girl doing?

ಮಾದರಿ: What is the girl doing? – She is playing with the dog. | Who is serving tea? – The lady is serving tea. | Where is the old man sitting? – He is sitting on the sofa. | How many children are there? – There is one child. | Is there a dog? – Yes, there is a dog.  (ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಆಧರಿಸಿ ಅಂಕ ನೀಡುವುದು.)
images/class-4/english/c4-en-l01-evening.webp
Practise speech – read and roleplay the dialogue (p. 15–16)
Look at the picture. Read the dialogue and roleplay it. Frame and write five questions about the picture.
ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಆಧರಿಸಿ ಅಂಕ ನೀಡುವುದು.
images/class-4/english/c4-en-l01-dialogue.webp
Rahim is new to Vijayapura. How will Rahim be able to reach the bus station?

He will walk straight along the road for fifty metres. Then he will take a left turn and walk twenty metres to reach the signal. He will cross the road and find the bus station on his left, on the main road.
Write more – A. Match pictures with descriptions and write a paragraph (p. 16–17)
Picture 1: a woman sitting in an armchair watching T.V. – which description matches?
d. Ashwini was watching T.V. when suddenly she heard a blast in the kitchen.
images/class-4/english/c4-en-l01-story-p17.webp
Picture 2: a woman at the door of the room – which description matches?
b. She ran towards the kitchen and closed the door.
images/class-4/english/c4-en-l01-story-p16.webp
Picture 3: a woman on a stool near the window – which description matches?
e. She wanted to escape through the window. But it was risky.
Picture 4: a woman sitting and calling on the phone – which description matches?
a. She called the firemen.
Picture 5: a fireman with a ladder rescuing the woman – which description matches?
c. Fortunately for her the fireman came and with the help of a ladder got her out of the house.
Rewrite the descriptions in the form of a paragraph.

Ashwini was watching T.V. when suddenly she heard a blast in the kitchen. She ran towards the kitchen and closed the door. She wanted to escape through the window, but it was risky. So she called the firemen. Fortunately for her, the fireman came and with the help of a ladder got her out of the house.
Advertisements – match the products with the right advertisement (p. 18)
Example: Want to feel the presence of God? Use ‘Gulabi’ fragrant stick to find God. (Picture: incense sticks)
ಉದಾಹರಣೆ (ಮಾದರಿ) – ಮುಂದಿನ ಉತ್ತರಗಳಿಗೆ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿ.
images/class-4/english/c4-en-l01-ads.webp
Broom – which advertisement?
Like to have a clean house? Then go for ‘Tiger’ brand broom stick.
Pencil – which advertisement?
Sad! That you could not top the class? Use ‘123’ pencil. You’ll be the topper.
Bicycle – which advertisement?
Always late to school? Ride on ‘Ambari’ to reach fast and safe to school.
Project and memory game (ಯೋಜನೆ ಮತ್ತು ನೆನಪಿನ ಆಟ) (p. 19–20)
Project: Bring at least 3 pieces of ads from any newspaper and discuss how they are written.
ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಆಧರಿಸಿ ಅಂಕ ನೀಡುವುದು (ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರ ಸಹಾಯದಿಂದ).
Let’s test your memory. Look at the pictures, close the book and write the names of the things.
pen, scale (ruler), comb, book, tub, plant, tree, rose, dog, slate, eraser, chalk, table, chair, bench, car, plate, cup, cloth, teapot, hand, bird, foot, eye  (ಚಿತ್ರ ಆಧಾರಿತ – ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ)
images/class-4/english/c4-en-l01-memory-p19.webp
Look at the second set of pictures, close the book and write the names of the things.
school bag, pencil, paintbrush, teddy bear, bottle, eraser, sharpener, tin, soap, notebook, pillow, bucket  (ಚಿತ್ರ ಆಧಾರಿತ – ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ)
images/class-4/english/c4-en-l01-memory-p20.webp

lessons.words: rook – a black bird of the crow family; labour – work hard; crooked – not straight, bent or curved; slender – thin; twig – a small, dry woody piece fallen from a branch; tuft – a piece of hair or grass; moss – a very small green or yellow plant; arrived – reached a place; bounced – moved quickly away from a surface after hitting it; growled – made a low sound, usually in anger; stare – look for a long time with eyes wide open; horrified – shocked very much
ab: Listen, recite and enjoy – The Rooks (ಕವನ ಕೇಳಿ, ಹೇಳಿ ಆನಂದಿಸಿ) (p. 21)
Teacher recites the poem. Listen with your book closed, then with your book open. Recite the poem with the teacher.
ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರ ಜೊತೆ ಕವನ ಹೇಳಿ (ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆ).
Speak / Read aloud – Yes or No, then a short answer (p. 22–23)
1. Can the rooks build their nest?
Yes, they can. Yes, they can build their nest.
2. Do the rooks sing?
No, they can’t. No, they can’t sing.
3. Are they up in the morning?
Yes, they are. They are up before the break of day.
4. Are they busy all the day?
Yes, they are. They labour busily as long as it is light.
5. Are their nests made of paper?
No, they are not. Their nests are made of crooked sticks, slender twigs and tufts of moss.
6. Do they talk alone?
No, they don’t. They talk together.
Write well 1 – fill in the blanks using the pictures (p. 23)
1. The rooks build their ___ on the ___.
nests; tree  (ಚಿತ್ರ ಆಧಾರಿತ)
images/class-4/english/c4-en-l02-rooks-fill.webp
2. They are up before the ___.
break of day
3. They build their nest with ___, a slender twig and a tuft of moss.
crooked sticks
4. Their nests look ___ and big.
round
5. They all talk ___.
together
Write well 2 – complete the passage by choosing words (p. 23)
They build their nest every ___. (winter / spring)
spring
They are up ___ the break of day. (before / after)
before
They bring many ___ sticks, slender twigs and tufts of moss. (crooked / straight)
crooked
They build their nest round and ___. (small / big)
big
They crow ___ in the rainy weather. (caw caw / meo meo)
caw caw
Sing and enjoy – Vegetables rhyme (ಪದ್ಯ ಹಾಡಿ ಆನಂದಿಸಿ) (p. 24)
Teacher recites / sings. Listen, then open the book and recite / sing in chorus.
ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರ ಜೊತೆ ಹಾಡು ಹೇಳಿ (ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆ).
Now read the poem and fill in the blanks – My Shadow (ಕವನ ಓದಿ ಖಾಲಿ ಜಾಗ ತುಂಬಿ) (p. 25)
When the sun shines, I can see my shadow right in front of ___.
me
images/class-4/english/c4-en-l02-shadow.webp
When I hop, my shadow ___!
hops
And when I stop, my shadow ___!
stops
The House of Mirrors – Read and enjoy (ಕಥೆ ಓದಿ ಆನಂದಿಸಿ) (p. 26–27)
Teacher reads the lesson. Listen with your book closed, then with your book open. Learn the new words: arrived, wagging, bounced, growled, stare, horrified.
ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರು ಕಥೆ ಓದುವುದನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ; ನಂತರ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ತೆರೆದು ಓದಿ.
images/class-4/english/c4-en-l02-mirrors-house.webp
Speak – Read the statements and say yes or no (p. 28)
1. The village was small.
Yes.
2. The house was of thousand dogs.
No. It was of thousand mirrors.
3. A little dog was happy.
Yes. A little dog was happy.
4. The little dog decided to visit the park.
No. The little dog decided to visit the House of Mirrors.
5. The first dog felt it was a wonderful place.
Yes. He felt it was a wonderful place.
6. The second dog saw friendly dogs staring back at him.
No. He saw a thousand unfriendly dogs staring back at him.
Write well – A. Complete the paragraph with words from the brackets (happy, unfriendly, house, dogs) (p. 28)
One day a dog entered the ___ of mirrors.
house
He was happy there as he saw many happy ___.
dogs
Into the same house entered another dog. He was not as ___ as the other one.
happy
He saw many ___. They stared back at him.
dogs
They were ___.
unfriendly
Match and write each question with the correct answer – B. (p. 29)
1. How was the village?
It was a small, far away village.
2. Which place did the dog decide to visit?
The dog decided to visit the House of Mirrors.
3. How did he look through the doorway?
With his ears lifted high and wagging tail.
4. How did another dog enter the house of mirrors?
He slowly climbed the stairs with his head hung low.
5. What did another dog see in the house of mirrors?
He saw a thousand unfriendly looking dogs.
Practise speech – read the dialogue and roleplay (p. 29–30)
Read the dialogue between Harshit and Kalyani and roleplay it. (Harshit: Shall I come tomorrow evening? Kalyani: Yes. You are always welcome.)
ಪಾತ್ರಾಭಿನಯ (ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆ).
images/class-4/english/c4-en-l02-dialogue.webp
Complete the dialogue with the words given (can you, straight, left, thank you) (p. 30)
Girl: Excuse me, ___ please tell me where Roshan Clinic is?
can you
Man: Go ___, take a ___ turn.
straight; left
Girl: Ok. ___.
thank you
Read, imagine and write – The Ant and the Dove (ಕಥೆ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಿ) (p. 31–32)
1. Complete with the help of the picture and clues [luckily – pigeon – flew by]
Luckily, a pigeon flew by and saw the ant struggling in the water. (ಮಾದರಿ ಉತ್ತರ)
images/class-4/english/c4-en-l02-ant-story.webp
2. Clues [pigeon – flew – nearby – tree]
The pigeon flew to a nearby tree and picked a leaf. (ಮಾದರಿ ಉತ್ತರ)
3. Clues [pigeon – help – ant – leaf]
The pigeon dropped the leaf into the water to help the ant. The ant climbed onto the leaf. (ಮಾದರಿ ಉತ್ತರ)
4. Clues [ant – out – pigeon – fly]
The ant came out of the water safely and thanked the pigeon. Then the pigeon flew away happily. (ಮಾದರಿ ಉತ್ತರ)

iq.q: ಚಿತ್ರವನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ಉತ್ತರಿಸಿ: What does the boy’s shadow do when he hops?

iq.a: A pigeon is in the picture.

iq.q: ಚಿತ್ರವನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ಉತ್ತರಿಸಿ: What shape are the rooks’ nests in the picture?

lessons.words: chop – cut down; dump – fill in any vacant place with dirt or waste; protect – save; trash – something that is useless or waste; fortunate – lucky; honourable – respectful; mercy – kind feelings; alive – living
ab: Listen, recite and enjoy – If a Tree Could Talk (ಕವನ ಕೇಳಿ, ಹೇಳಿ ಆನಂದಿಸಿ) (p. 33)
Teacher recites the poem. Listen with your book closed, then with your book open. Recite with the teacher.
ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರ ಜೊತೆ ಕವನ ಹೇಳಿ (ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆ).
Speak / Read aloud – A. Say what you would do to save the environment (p. 34)
1. I would grow more trees but I wouldn’t chop them down. (ಉದಾಹರಣೆ)
chop (ಉದಾಹರಣೆ)
images/class-4/english/c4-en-l03-tree-x.webp
2. I would save the river but I wouldn’t ___ trash.
dump in
3. I would ride a bicycle but I wouldn’t ___ a car.
drive
4. I would rear animals but I wouldn’t ___ them.

5. I would light oil lamps but I wouldn’t ___ crackers.

Read the pictures and say about the weather – B. (p. 35)
It is a sunny day. It is very hot. (ಉದಾಹರಣೆ)

rainy; wet  (ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಉತ್ತರ ಆಧರಿಸಿ – ಉದಾ: cold)

cloudy; dark  (ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಉತ್ತರ ಆಧರಿಸಿ – ಉದಾ: cool)

windy; cool  (ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಉತ್ತರ ಆಧರಿಸಿ – ಉದಾ: strong)

Teacher sings the song. Listen, then open the book and sing.
ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರ ಜೊತೆ ಹಾಡು ಹೇಳಿ (ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆ).

nest

Example: weather, whether
